text: dsh-finalize 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的文件交付检查插件，会在 present 或 qqbot_send_file 等配置的交付工具执行前处理文档。它可清理 DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 和 ODF 文件中的生成器痕迹、模板缩略图并重算可推导的统计信息；还会检查六种语言的标点，并把不能从文件证明的事项列入报告。PDF 只读取文本层并检查，不改写文件。交付报告可在消息操作区的面板查看，也能扫描最近的 Office 文件。适合需要在发送文档前整理文件并复核未解决项目的 DSH 用户；无需 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-finalize checks files before DSH delivery. It cleans document metadata and recomputes available statistics in Office files, checks punctuation in six languages, and reports unresolved items. PDFs are read-only. Review results in the message panel or scan recent files.
想在文件发出去前自动整理文档属性并检查标点
交付 DOCX 或表格时，能不能顺便重算文档统计信息？
我想查看文件检查发现的问题，并区分已修正和待人工处理的项目
能否在 DSH 里扫描最近的 Office 文件并生成交付检查报告？
I want to check and normalize Office document metadata before sending a file.
Can DSH report punctuation issues in a document without changing the text?
dsh-finalize 的功能「交付前文档整理」：在配置的文件交付工具执行前处理 DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 和 ODF 文档，清理部分生成器元数据、重算可推导统计并移除模板缩略图。
dsh-finalize 的功能「多语言标点检查」：从文档段落提取文本并按语言检查标点混用、重复符号和引号配对问题；结果作为待处理报告显示，不自动替换文本。
dsh-finalize 的功能「交付检查面板」：消息操作区提供盾牌按钮，打开面板查看每个文件已修正、待人工处理和只读提示，也可发起最近文件扫描。
dsh-finalize 的功能「最近文件扫描」：用户在报告面板触发扫描后，插件从工作目录中按修改时间选取最多 scanLimit 个 Office 文件，逐个运行检查并更新报告。
让 DSH 在发送文档前自动检查文件内容和统计信息。
I need a panel showing what was fixed and what still needs a human review after document delivery.

dsh-finalize README · dsh-finalize：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that runs **one finalize pass the moment a file is delivered** — and nowhere else. It strips the fingerprints document libraries leave behind, recomputes the statistics that are actually derivable, and puts everything it **will not** fabricate into a side panel instead of writing it into the file.

dsh-finalize README · dsh-finalize：> **Design rule: fix what is provably wrong, never invent evidence.**
> Edit time, revision history, comments and "was written by a human" claims are reported, not written. `Application` is removed rather than replaced with a fake `Microsoft Office Word 16.0` string — absence is unremarkable, a lie contradicts the rest of the package.

dsh-finalize README · Why this exists：Documents produced by `python-docx`, `python-pptx`, `openpyxl` or LibreOffice carry their own birth certificate: a creator field naming the library, a 2013 template date, `Words=0` on a forty-page report, a leftover template thumbnail. Those are bugs, not style choices, and anyone who unzips the file can see them.

dsh-finalize README · Why this exists：The usual advice — forge the edit time, invent a revision count — makes things worse. It contradicts the fields you cannot change (the `rsid` trail, the real save history) and collapses the moment someone looks. This plugin takes the honest half: normalize what is wrong, report what only a human can supply.

dsh-finalize README · What it does：| Format | Automatic fixes | Reported, never fixed |
|---|---|---|
| `docx` | creator and description, template date, `Application`/`AppVersion`, word/character/paragraph/line counts, template thumbnail | `TotalTime=0`, missing comments, missing tracked changes, page count |
| `pptx` | same core properties, slide/notes/hidden-slide counts, word counts | no speaker notes, cropped images still in `ppt/media`, hidden slides |
| `xlsx` | core properties, `TitlesOfParts` aligned to sheet names | zero formulas, pivot cache retaining deleted rows, external links, hidden sheets |
| `odt` `ods` `odp` | `meta:generator`, creator, dates, `meta:document-statistic`, thumbnail and its manifest entry | `meta:editing-duration=PT0S`, single save cycle, no annotations, no tracked changes |
| `pdf` | **nothing — read-only by design** | Producer/Creator/XMP, incremental updates, missing bookmarks, signatures, punctuation in extractable text |

dsh-finalize README · What it does：Several files in one delivery are processed independently. Several deliveries in one session merge into a single report for 30 minutes instead of overwriting each other.

dsh-finalize README · Text checks：When a document is delivered, its paragraphs are also checked for punctuation that does not match their language. The language is detected per paragraph from script counts (Han / Kana / Hangul / Latin), and Latin paragraphs are separated into English, French and German by diacritics and stop words.

dsh-finalize README · Text checks：| Language | Expected | Flagged example |
|---|---|---|
| Chinese | `，。！？；：、（）“”` | `这是测试,包含逗号` |
| Japanese | `、。「」『』` | `テスト，です` |
| Korean | ASCII `, . ? !` | `테스트，입니다` |
| English / French / German | ASCII, plus each language's own quotes (`« »`, `„ “`) | `sentence，with` |

Also flagged: spaces before punctuation, three or more repeated marks, and unbalanced `“ ”` / `「 」` / `『 』`.

dsh-finalize README · Text checks：Findings are **reported, never rewritten** — a blind character swap damages code, URLs, formulas and citations far more often than it helps. In the panel every finding group can be expanded into its individual occurrences (up to 50, each with the original snippet and the suggested replacement). URLs, e-mail addresses, paths, decimals and list numbers (`1.`, `3.2`) are skipped entirely; spreadsheet cells are only checked when longer than eight characters.

dsh-finalize README · Text checks：PDF text is decoded from the text layer: Flate content streams, `Tj`/`TJ` operators and per-font `ToUnicode` maps, including Identity-H CID fonts, so Word and LibreOffice exports are covered. Scanned pages, fonts without a `ToUnicode` map and text drawn as outlines cannot be read — those files are reported as *not checked* rather than guessed at.

dsh-finalize README · Text checks：**Only your own text is judged.** When the delivered document reuses paragraphs from a file the user supplied, those paragraphs are treated as the template: they are never listed as problems, and their punctuation style becomes the accepted style for new text — a template that writes `一:` makes the assistant's `二:` correct, not an error. Text the user edited themselves falls into the same bucket: noted, never changed.

dsh-finalize README · Text checks：Detection is automatic: the newest sibling Office file that is older than the delivery and shares at least a quarter of its paragraphs (minimum three) becomes the baseline. `textCheck.templates` pins explicit paths, `textCheck.baseline: false` turns detection off.

dsh-finalize README · Install：The plugin is a DSH bundle — a plain package with a `dsh.bundle.patch`; there is no build step and no runtime dependency.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hengyun721/dsh-finalize.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-finalize
```

Or from inside the Harness, install the checkout directory with the plugin manager (`install_bundle`, target = the absolute path above). Restart once if it reports `restart-required`.

dsh-finalize README · Usage：Nothing to call. Deliver a file with `present` (or a configured transport) and the pass runs **before** the tool executes, so the file on disk is already normalized when it reaches the recipient. The text check runs only for delivered documents — ordinary chat replies are never scanned.

dsh-finalize README · Usage：Relative paths are resolved against the session's working directory, not the Host process directory. A file that cannot be read is reported as a failure in the panel, counted in the badge, and shown with the original path next to the resolved one — it never disappears silently.

A shield icon appears in the message action row next to copy / like / dislike / branch:

dsh-finalize README · Usage：| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| grey | no delivery in this session yet |
| amber with a count | that many items need a human |
| click | panel with `fixed` / `open` / `read-only` rows per file |

The panel also offers **Scan recent files**, which runs the pass on the newest Office files in the working directory without a delivery — handy when a document was produced by a script rather than through `present`.

dsh-finalize README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `author` | string | `''` | Written into `dc:creator`, `lastModifiedBy` and `meta:initial-creator`. Empty clears generator names without inventing a person. |
| `triggerTools` | string[] | `present`, `qqbot_send_file` | Delivery tools that trigger the pass. |
| `formats` | string[] | all seven | Adapter whitelist; anything else is reported as `skipped`. |
| `scanLimit` | number | `5` | How many recent files **Scan recent files** processes. |
| `autoFix.stripGeneratorFields` | boolean | `true` | Remove library names and `generated by …` descriptions. |
| `autoFix.dropApplicationField` | boolean | `true` | Remove `Application`/`AppVersion` instead of faking an Office version. |
| `autoFix.recomputeStats` | boolean | `true` | Recompute word/character/paragraph counters from the body. |
| `textCheck.punctuation` | boolean | `true` | Run the punctuation check on document text. |
| `textCheck.languages` | string[] | all six | Language codes the checker may flag: `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `en`, `fr`, `de`. |
| `textCheck.templates` | string[] | `[]` | Explicit template paths, relative to the delivered fi

dsh-finalize README · Repository layout：| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half. Registers the `tools/pre-execute` hook on the delivery tools, routes each file to an adapter, merges per-session reports, and serves `/api/finalize.report` and `/api/finalize.scan`. Registers no tool and no prompt section. |
| `client.js` | Browser half. Registers the shield button into `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` and renders the report panel (fixed overlay, theme tokens, no DOM writes outside its own tree). |
| `lib/office.js` | Format engine, dependency-free. ZIP reader/writer (`node:zlib`), OOXML adapters (`docx`/`pptx`/`xlsx`), ODF adapter (`odt`/`ods`/`odp`), read-only PDF inspector. |
| `lib/punctuation.js` | Text checker. Per-paragraph language detection (`zh`/`ja`/`ko`/`en`/`fr`/`de`) and the punctuation rules; returns grouped findings with snippets and suggested replacements. |
| `lib/pdf-text.js` | Heuristic PDF text extraction: object streams, Flate content streams, `Tj`/`TJ` decoding and `ToUnicode` CMaps. Used only for the punctuation check; it never writes. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: inserts the `dsh-finalize` row and the default config. This is

dsh-finalize README · Engine map：| Symbol | Role |
|---|---|
| `readZip(buffer)` | Parse the central directory into `{ name, data, time, date }` entries. No ZIP64. |
| `writeZip(entries)` | Rebuild the archive with `deflateRaw`. Entries named `mimetype` are stored uncompressed and keep their position, as ODF requires. |
| `finalizeDocx` / `finalizePptx` / `finalizeXlsx` | OOXML adapters; they share `fixCore`, `stripApplication`, `dropThumbnail` and `commonUnresolved`. |
| `finalizeOdf` | ODF adapter over `meta.xml` and `META-INF/manifest.xml`. |
| `inspectPdf` | Regex-level PDF inspector; returns observations only and never rewrites bytes. |
| `finalizeOffice(bytes, kind, options)` | Dispatcher used by the Host half. |

dsh-finalize README · Compatibility：- **No tool, no prompt section.** Nothing is added to the model's tool list or system prompt, so token accounting and tool selection are untouched.
- **One passive listener.** `tools/pre-execute` runs only for the configured delivery tools, always returns `next()`, and swallows its own failures, so it can neither block nor rewrite another tool's call.
- **No transport coupling.** It hooks the delivery tool, not a transport, so QQ, Web and CLI transports keep working.
- **Namespaced surface.** Routes are `/api/finalize.report` and `/api/finalize.scan`; the slot id is `dsh-finalize`. Neither collides with the shipped `deliverables`, `changes.*` or `presented` routes.
- **Opt-in debug only.** Nothing is written outside the delivered files unless `DSH_FINALIZE_DEBUG=1`.

dsh-finalize README · Limits：- Page counts need a layout engine; the plugin reports rather than guesses.
- ODF support rewrites `meta.xml` and the manifest thumbnail entry, nothing else. Verified structurally; opening in LibreOffice is not covered by CI.
- Legacy binary formats (`doc`, `xls`, `ppt`), `rtf` and `ipynb` are not implemented. `doc` stores a *real* accumulated edit time in `PIDSI_EDITTIME` — worth adding before reaching for anything cosmetic.
- This is not an authorship detector and does not claim a file "looks human". It removes noise and reports contradictions.

dsh-finalize README · Debugging：Set `DSH_FINALIZE_DEBUG=1` before starting the Harness to write `dsh-finalize.log` and `dsh-finalize-last.json` into the OS temp directory. Off by default; nothing is written to your workspace.

Nothing else touches the disk: document bytes are read into memory and written back in place, there are no temporary copies, no sidecar files and no cache. On Windows the debug files land in `%TEMP%` (`C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp`), on macOS and Linux in `$TMPDIR` and `/tmp`.

dsh-finalize README · Development：```bash
npm run check   # node --check on the three runtime files
npm test        # four unit tests, no dependencies
```

`npm test` runs the test file in-process so it also works inside sandboxed terminals where the test runner cannot spawn children.
